author: Nate Miller
title: Trea Turner continues to cook at the dish
desc: Trea Turner went 2-for-5 with a two-run homer, a double, three RBI, and two runs scored in Tuesday's 8-0 win over the Pirates.
impact: Turner has homered each of the last two nights against the Pirates, and he has come up with two hits in six of his last eight games. In that stretch, Turner has hit a cool .342 with a .938 OPS, six RBI, nine runs scored, and a steal.

author: Nate Miller
title: Justin Crawford drives in three runs Tuesday night
desc: Justin Crawford went 3-for-3 with a double, three RBI, and one run scored in Tuesday's 8-0 win over the Pirates.
impact: Crawford has gotten going at the plate. The fleet-footed rookie has come up with multiple hits each of the last two games, and three times over his last six games. During that six-game span, Crawford has gone 9-for-21 overall, raising his average 16 points in the process.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jorge Mateo steals a base, scores twice in Tuesday's loss
desc: Jorge Mateo went 1-for-2 with a walk, a steal, and two runs scored in Tuesday's 5-3 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: Mateo had a productive night for the still slumping Braves, as he continues to be a solid, part-time player this season. The speedy 31-year-old is now batting a serviceable .266 through 109 at-bats to go with four homers, 11 RBI, 27 runs, and nine stolen bases.

author: Nate Miller
title: Cristopher Sanchez shuts down Pirates in Tuesday's win
desc: Cristopher Sanchez gave up only three hits and two walks while striking out nine over seven shutout innings in Tuesday's 8-0 win over the Pirates.
impact: Following one of his weakest efforts of the season, Sanchez bounced right back into form with a dominant performance Tuesday night. The lefty is now one of just three pitchers to reach double-digit wins to this point, as he'll move forward with a 10-3 record and an elite 2.00 ERA through 18 starts. Sanchez is among the top few hurlers in the league at present.

author: Nate Miller
title: Martin Perez burned by rough fourth inning Tuesday night
desc: Martin Perez gave up four runs on five hits and three walks while striking out just one over five innings in Tuesday's 5-3 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: Perez pitched well Tuesday night aside from a four-run fourth inning that ultimately saddled him with the loss. The veteran southpaw has had a pair of sub-par performances in a row now, and lacking command has been the main culprit. Perez has allowed seven earned runs while walking seven batters over nine innings between his last two outings. He's in line to return to the mound Sunday afternoon against the Mets.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Cade Cavalli flirts with perfection in 13-K gem vs. Boston
desc: Cade Cavalli allowed zero earned runs on one hit and zero walks while striking out 13 over seven innings in Tuesday's win over the Red Sox.
impact: After the win, Cavalli now has a 3.69 ERA and 1.33 WHIP to go with a 5-4 record across 18 starts. Cavalli turned in his best outing of the season and he will look to continue that against Houston in his next scheduled start.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: CJ Abrams Goes Yard as Nats Rout Red Sox
desc: CJ Abrams went 1-for-5 in Tuesday's 8-1 win over the Red Sox with a home run, a run scored, one RBI and two strikeouts.
impact: After Tuesday's win over Boston, Abrams is batting .273 with 18 home runs, 60 RBI, 52 runs scored and 12 stolen bases across 84 games. Abrams' bat had gone quiet over the last seven games, but he has recorded a hit and at least one RBI in both games so far against Boston.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: James Wood piles up three hits in rout of Boston
desc: James Wood went 3-for-5 in Tuesday's 8-1 win over the Red Sox with a double, two RBI, and one strikeout.
impact: Through 87 games this season, he's batting .263 with 21 homers, 52 RBI, 73 runs scored, and 13 stolen bases. Wood has struggled at the plate lately, so maybe this strong performance will set up a turn around heading into the All-Star break.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Trey Gibson shelled early in short start vs. White Sox
desc: Trey Gibson lasted just 2.2 innings Tuesday, allowing eight earned runs on seven hits and six walks while striking out five over 78 pitches in a loss to the White Sox.
impact: He now owns an 7.36 ERA and 1.91 WHIP with a 1-3 record through seven starts this season. With Dean Kremer expected to return from the injured list soon, Gibson may have made his last start for the Orioles for the foreseeable future.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Joe Ryan gets rocked early in loss to Astros
desc: Joe Ryan allowed six earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out five over four innings in Tuesday's 6-4 loss to Houston.
impact: Ryan didn't have his usual margin for error, and the Astros made sure of it. After the outing, he now carries a 3.61 ERA and 1.08 WHIP with a 5-5 record and 113 strikeouts across 18 starts. Ryan will make his next start against the Guardians on Tuesday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Matthew Liberatore picks up whiffs and walks in win
desc: Matthew Liberatore allowed one earned run on one hit and four walks while striking out nine over five innings in Tuesday's win over the Braves.
impact: After the 5-3 victory, Liberatore now owns a 5.33 ERA and 1.55 WHIP with a 4-5 record through 17 starts. He allowed only three hard hits and picked up 15 whiffs on 98 pitches. The walks were a season high, but the single hit is his best mark of 2026. He'll look to keep it going next time out against the Cubs on the road.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Busch connects for homer Tuesday
desc: Michael Busch went 1-for-4 with a home run, a walk, one run scored and one RBI in Tuesday's 9-7 win over the San Diego Padres.
impact: Busch hit a 424-foot home run off left-hander J.P. Sears in the fifth inning, marking his third homer off a lefty this season. He has put together a solid campaign through 85 games, posting a .233/.368/.388 slash line with 10 home runs. He'll look to provide fantasy managers with more pop in July after hitting four home runs in June.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kyle Manzardo Clubs Solo Shot, But Guards Fall 4-2
desc: Kyle Manzardo went 1-for-3 in Tuesday's loss to the Rangers with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Manzardo provided the lone punch in a losing effort and continues to be a three-true-outcomes kind of bat. After Tuesday's loss, Manzardo is batting .231 with 10 home runs, 29 RBI, 29 runs scored, a .313 wOBA, and a .105 walk rate through 76 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Mookie Betts racks up three hits in win
desc: Mookie Betts went 3-for-5 in Tuesday's 9-3 win over the Athletics with a double, a run scored and an RBI.
impact: Through 51 games, Betts is batting .244 with 11 home runs, 28 RBI, 31 runs scored and one steal. He finished June batting .290 with five homers, five doubles, 17 runs scored, and 12 RBI.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Daniel Schneemann swipes bag in 2-hit loss
desc: Daniel Schneemann went 2-for-3 in a 4-2 loss to the Rangers with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: Schneemann kept it simple and at least ran a little, even as Cleveland came up short. After Tuesday's loss, Schneemann is batting .219 with six home runs, 27 RBI, 25 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 70 games.
